profile.headline: Software Developer

positions.title: York Solutions, B2E Software Developer
positions.description:
Collaborated closely with a cross-functional team to develop and implement new features based on client requirements.Utilized Java, JavaScript, and SQL to create robust and efficient solutions for enhancing product functionality.
Successfully resolved assigned defects within the same day they were assigned, demonstrating strong problem-solving skills, task ptioritization, and efficiency in addressing issues promptly.
Worked in an agile development environment, actively participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and code reviews.
Conducted thorough testing and debugging to ensure high-quality deliverables and seamless user experiences.
positions.insights: Camunda BPM, REST APIs and +18 skills

positions.title: B2E Technical Training Consultant, York Solutions
positions.description:
Completed intensive training in full-stack development with a focus on Angular, Spring Boot, and Docker technologies.Developed a range of projects during the training program, showcasing proficiency in implementing full-stack solutions.
Designed and developed robust full-stack applications encompassing front-end and back-end functionalities for note creation and storage, event invitation and scheduling through a calendar app, and blog posting with features such as view and like tracking.
Developed and implemented REST APIs to seamlessly connect the client-facing application with the backend application and database.
positions.insights: Camunda BPM, REST APIs and +15 skills

positions.title: Senior Sales Associate
positions.description:
Licensed insurance producer managing leads utilizing both inbound and outbound communication to guide clients and agents in calls to understand their situation, uncover additional needs, educate and provide insurance solutions.
Requested and actively contributed to the creation of an individual scorecard system, which was later implemented companywide. This initiative greatly aided in goal setting, individual development, and performance tracking.
Led comprehensive systems and equipment training for new employees, ensuring smooth onboarding and proficiency, and provided exceptional user support by promptly addressing and resolving software and hardware issues.
Coordinated and facilitated effective communication and smooth transitions between Managed Service Providers (MSPs), ensuring seamless operations.
positions.insights: Computer Literacy, Professional Skills and +10 skills
